_spec: THE FILM — the App Preview of MyWeli Pro, version 2 (README.md « Version 2 — the film »). S1, S2, S3, S6, S4 and the end card, cut from the takes of 2026-10-14, framed: 862 frames, 28.733 s. Until 2026-10-14 this was storyboard-scenes-alt-s6.json, « an alternative for the owner », marked rehearsal: S6 brought back from take5b, the keyed take, on the reading that S6's rule protects the salon's phone rather than the « Contact » block — the scroll is 290 pt, not short; it shows the map, the address, « WhatsApp » and the hours; the phone row is masked. S5 is out (with it the cut is 32.633 s). The five-scene cut it was offered against is storyboard-scenes-alt-s5.json, kept as the alternative, marked rehearsal. Takes are relative to --takes (build/app-store/pro/preview/v2/takes).
_chosen: The owner, 2026-10-14, after watching three cuts: « cut 1, and it is good as it is » — this storyboard, framed, as built under build/app-store/pro/preview/v2/alt-s6-take5b/framed/. Its content is that cut's, unchanged: no retiming, no re-cut, no new take, no new effect. The one change since: the poster's time (`_poster`).
_poster: 25.000 s of the film (frame 750), not 25.367 s (frame 761): App Store Connect sets the poster by a time code HH:MM:SS:FF whose last field, as the brief of 2026-10-14 put it, Apple does not define (frames or hundredths; not read in Apple's documentation here), and only a whole second reads the same both ways — 00:00:25:00. The full-bleed frame's poster is unchanged (it is not the film). S4 starts at 21.867 s (frame 656), so `at_s` is 94 frames, 3.1333… s. The picture is the one the approved poster showed: « Mois » at rest, 77 000 FCFA, its rows drawn — the take's picture at 17.925 s, the same composed frame (f_000744.png serves frames 744 to 775 of the approved cut, the rest of S4). 24.000 s is « Semaine »; 26.000 s is in the join to the end card.
_never_shown: sign-in; « Mon abonnement » or an offer; KYC (« Vérification »); a « Compte de démonstration — … » message; a system alert; a legible phone number; the « Prestations » price list as a scene. Checked by eye on the frames and by OCR of every decoded frame; the tool reads none of it.
